Legal

Privacy Policy

Last updated: January 1, 2025

1. Introduction

Platizio Services LLP ("Platizio", "we", "us", or "our") operates the Platizio Alternatives platform. This Privacy Policy describes how we collect, use, and safeguard information you provide when using our website and services. By accessing our platform, you consent to the practices described in this policy.

2. Information We Collect

We may collect the following categories of information:

  • check_small Identity information: Full legal name, entity name, PAN/TAN, and government-issued identification
  • check_small Contact information: Email address, phone number, registered office address
  • check_small Financial information: Investment objectives, risk tolerance, net worth declarations (for KYC/AML purposes)
  • check_small Usage data: Pages visited, time spent, referral sources, browser type, and IP address
  • check_small Communication records: Correspondence with our advisory and compliance teams

3. How We Use Your Information

Information is used exclusively for the following purposes:

  • check_small Processing your registration and onboarding as a sophisticated investor
  • check_small Providing access to fund information, analytics, and advisory services
  • check_small Compliance with SEBI AIF Regulations and PMLA requirements
  • check_small Communicating fund updates, regulatory notices, and investor reports
  • check_small Improving platform functionality and user experience

4. Data Sharing & Disclosure

We do not sell, rent, or trade your personal information. Information may be shared with:

  • check_small SEBI, PMLA-designated authorities, and other regulatory bodies when legally required
  • check_small Registered fund managers and trustees of AIFs in which you invest
  • check_small SEBI-registered KYC Registration Agencies (KRAs) for investor verification
  • check_small Auditors, legal advisors, and technology service providers under strict confidentiality agreements

5. Data Security

We employ industry-standard encryption (AES-256 at rest, TLS 1.3 in transit), multi-factor authentication, and role-based access controls. Our infrastructure undergoes annual penetration testing and is ISO 27001 aligned. Despite these measures, no digital transmission is completely secure, and we cannot guarantee absolute security.

6. Your Rights

Subject to applicable law, you may request access to, correction of, or deletion of your personal data. To exercise these rights, contact our Data Protection Officer at info.alternatives@platizio.com. We respond to verified requests within 30 business days.

7. Contact

For privacy-related inquiries: Platizio Services LLP, Data Protection Office, Unit DGL-229, Second Floor, DLF Galleria Mall, Mayur Vihar Phase-1, Delhi – 110 092. Email: info.alternatives@platizio.com. Telephone: +91 92055 23100
